root_cause.text: In sd_probe, when device_add(&sdkp->disk_dev) fails, the error path calls put_device (which frees the scsi_disk via scsi_disk_release) but does not call put_disk to release the gendisk reference, causing a gendisk reference leak.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "If device_add(&sdkp->disk_dev) fails, put_device() runs scsi_disk_release(), which frees the scsi_disk but leaves the gendisk referenced." The patch adds `put_disk(gd);` after `put_device(&sdkp->disk_dev);` to mirror the cleanup done in the device_add_disk() error path.

This condition enters the flawed error path where put_device is called but put_disk is missing.
This call releases the scsi_disk but does not release the associated gendisk, directly causing the reference leak.
This branch bypasses any opportunity to call put_disk, leaving the gendisk reference unreleased.
